messages:
Ava Martinez: Hi all 1 submitted my resignation. Last day 2025-06-20. Need quick confirmation on COBRA window, when benefits stop, final pay + PTO, laptop return steps, and how to book an exit interview. cc @People Ops
People Ops: Thanks Ava. Short answers:
- Benefits: employer coverage ends on your termination date (2025-06-20). COBRA packet from benefits admin will be emailed within ~7 business days; you have 60 days from packet date to elect. COBRA covers medical/dental/vision you had enrolled.
- Final pay: standard payroll will include last wages + accrued PTO on next payroll (target 2025-07-04). If you need earlier, we can request an off-cycle run (may take up to 3 business days). Submit outstanding expenses ASAP.
- Exit interview: optional 30-min with People Ops. Reply with 2 preferred time slots and we'll send an invite and a short questionnaire.
IT-Bot: Laptop return options: request pre-paid label via IT portal (https://redwood-internal/it/returns) or drop at HQ IT desk. Include `asset_tag` and `serial`. Default deprovision schedule: SSO & console access disabled at 18:00 local on termination date. If manager requests extension for handoff, open IT ticket.
Ava Martinez: Asset tag RBW-MBP-9981. Ill take the mail label. Also who handles 401(k) rollover?
PayrollBot: 401(k) vendor (Brightpath) will email rollover options ~10 days after separation. Final pay stub emailed after payroll run.
Jordan (Manager): If you need access for handoff, Jordan will request a 48-hour bridge. Ava 1 DM me the critical service accounts you own.
Ava Martinez: Will DM list tonight. For exit interview, Tue 2025-06-24 11am PT or Wed 2025-06-25 2pm PT work.
People Ops: Booked exit interview for Tue 2025-06-24 11:00-11:30 PT with People Ops rep. Invite and questionnaire sent. Summary checklist:
- COBRA packet ~7 business days post-termination; 60-day election window
- Coverage ends 2025-06-20; COBRA retroactive to 2025-06-21 if elected
- Final pay targeted 2025-07-04; submit expenses now
- IT: mail label requested; deprovision 2025-06-20 18:00 local unless ticketed
Ava Martinez: Thanks everyone 64f I'll send the token list and the device tomorrow.
